name: fpdf
expr: p_basic = fpdf(2, 5, 10); p_vec = fpdf(xv, 5, 10); p_neg = fpdf(xneg, 5, 10); p_v1bad = fpdf(2, 0, 10); p_v2bad = fpdf(2, 5, 0); p_v1neg = fpdf(2, -1, 10); p_at0_v1eq2 = fpdf(0, 2, 10);
comment: Sig: y = fpdf(x, v1, v2). F-distribution PDF. x < 0 => 0; v1 <= 0 or v2 <= 0 => NaN. Covers: scalar (v1=5,v2=10), vector x, x<0/x=0 edges, invalid v1/v2, F(2,10) at 0 (= v1/(v1+v2-2)/B(...) finite for v1=2).
